content: Krishiv is a builder focused on shipping practical, high-impact products at the intersection of AI, software, and UX, with a long-term goal of founding a tech startup.
He optimizes for speed of learning and user impact: prototype fast, test with real users, iterate toward polished, reliable systems.
International background (Hong Kong → Georgia Tech) shapes his bias for cross-cultural collaboration, clear communication, and community building.
GFO-X — Software Developer Intern (Summer 2024): built AI-driven Jira/Confluence agents for document classification and retrieval using embeddings + cosine similarity.
At GFO-X, implemented a RAG pipeline (vLLM + LangChain + PyTorch) and scored >90% on RAGAS metrics for internal knowledge tasks.
Designed a ReAct multi-agent workflow with gap analysis, automated ticketing, progress tracking, and sentiment checks for engineering ops.
Cut QA time by ~70% using pytest suites and automation; shipped a production-ready PoC in <2 months adopted by 5+ business units.
Built a Confluence scraper and classifier to populate 1,000+ docs into PostgreSQL for fast semantic search across engineering and ops.
Collaborated across infra, development, market ops, quant, and compliance—demonstrating applied AI inside a regulated finance context.
SlideIn — AI cold-outreach platform: won 1st place at Georgia Tech Shipathon; launch reached 500k+ impressions across social platforms.
SlideIn generates personalized emails, automates sending, tracks replies, and visualizes analytics; framed as 'Tinder for outreach'.
Tech stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Supabase, OpenAI API; focus on deliverability, logging, and real-time analytics for iteration.
Demonstrates product execution under time constraints: built core MVP <24 hours with clean UX, onboarding, and demo-ready flows.
LinkUp — mobile social event discovery for Southeast Asia (Hong Kong, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur); Gen-Z-focused UI.
Implements user auth, event creation/RSVPs, private/invite-only events, and a friends system (requests, approvals, social feed).
Tech stack: React Native (Expo), TypeScript, Supabase; animated bottom tabs, dark theme, and modern mobile patterns.
Business angle: early manual event curation and commission-based organizer deals to prove traction and monetize discovery.
Agent Zeta — research toward agent 'intuition' using dynamic knowledge graphs for reasoning beyond straightforward task execution.
Focus: orchestration over a world model that links entities and risks; explores psychological tasks and risk-rooted demos.
Technical themes: graph schemas (Neo4j), retrieval + reasoning loops, causal edges, and tool-augmented agent plans.
Bluetooth Light Switch — Arduino + Adafruit Bluefruit LE UART + servo to toggle a physical switch via phone; built to automate a bunk-bed dorm setup.
Demonstrates embedded C++, UART parsing, power distribution, and 3D-printed mounts for robust everyday use.
Autonomous Delivery Robot — path-planning, obstacle avoidance, and async control for maze navigation, waypoint delivery, and sweeping.
Asynchronous programming in C++ to process sensor input and drive motors concurrently for smooth real-time navigation.
Flow AI — extracts structured data from syllabi and generates gamified, bite-sized study plans using OpenAI API.
Heston Volatility Model — implemented stochastic volatility pricing with attention to arbitrage constraints for realistic option dynamics.
Shark Sanctuary NFT Collection — 888 NFTs on Polygon with Hong Kong Shark Foundation to raise awareness against shark finning.
Received media coverage (RTHK 3, Around Discovery Bay); combined coding, art generation, and cause-driven storytelling.
Python: data processing, backend services, AI tooling, and automation; comfortable structuring production-ready packages.
FastAPI: builds typed, testable REST endpoints with Pydantic schemas, auth, and rate limiting where needed.
Pytest: rigorous unit/integration tests; CI-friendly; used to cut QA time ~70% in internship projects.
LangChain: tools, agents (ReAct), retrieval chains, and evaluation harnesses; integrated with vLLM for efficient inference.
Embeddings & RAG: chunking strategies, top-k tuning, hybrid search; experience with RAGAS for retrieval quality.
Knowledge Graphs: Neo4j for entity/relationship modeling; uses graph queries to support reasoning and orchestration layers.
Databases: Postgres/Supabase (auth, policies, RPC), vector stores (Chroma, pgvector), and indexing best practices.
Frontend: React/Next.js, Tailwind, motion/animation, accessibility, and clean typographic hierarchy.
Mobile: React Native (Expo), TypeScript, navigation patterns, and performance-aware UI for iOS/Android.
Embedded/Robotics: Arduino C++, UART/BLE, servo control, sensor fusion patterns, and async event loops.
GFO-X tech stack: vLLM, LangChain, PyTorch, pytest, PostgreSQL, embeddings, cosine similarity, Confluence/Jira automation.
SlideIn tech stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Supabase, OpenAI API; analytics + reply tracking pipelines.
LinkUp tech stack: React Native (Expo), TypeScript, Supabase (auth, RLS), animated UI and dark mode.
Agent Zeta tech: Neo4j graph modeling, retrieval+reasoning loops, tool-use orchestration, and agent simulation tasks.
Fundfluent (Summers 2022–2023): built an AI-assisted SEO blogging workflow; supported SME-focused product experiments.
PolyU (2021–2022): passive PEM fuel cell car; mentored by Mechanical Engineering faculty; experimentation and parameter testing.
Head Student, West Island School (2021–2022): represented ~18k students from 80+ nationalities; led inclusive initiatives.
Kids4Kids: led ~25 volunteers for tutoring; produced 30+ STEM videos; partnered to distribute hands-on learning kits.
Startup Exchange (2025–present): community growth; co-hosts with AI/FinTech/VC orgs; builds bridges for student founders.
Venture Capital Club (2024–present): research analyst; prepares AI startup trend analyses and newsletter content.
Shipathon 2025: SlideIn won 1st place; demo emphasized fast execution, UX clarity, and measurable outreach impact.
IYPT/HKYPT: bronze at HKYPT; represented Hong Kong at IYPT, placing 15th globally—speaking to research and defense skills.
AI/ML applications that integrate into real workflows (retrieval, agents, eval), not just demos.
Startups & VC: interested in founder-market fit, distribution, and go-to-market for AI-native products.
FinTech: applying AI to knowledge retrieval, process automation, and risk-aware decision support.
Developer Experience: clean APIs, fast feedback loops, and ergonomic tooling for builders.
Plays guitar; treats music as a creative reset and a way to sharpen focus.
Hiking/outdoors for balance and clarity; enjoys exploring trails around Georgia and abroad.
Travel: enjoys discovering new cultures and food; international upbringing informs comfort in diverse teams.
Values reliability, clarity, and tasteful design—prefers minimal, professional interfaces with thoughtful motion.
Seeks environments that combine pace with craftsmanship—ship fast without compromising code quality or UX.
Georgia Tech: CS/CE coursework includes Python, Java, data structures, OOP, systems, and AI foundations.
Plans to take CREATE-X and build a venture-backed-ready MVP; interested in enterprise AI and consumer productivity.
Testing & QA: pytest, mocking, fixtures, coverage; regression suites for backend reliability and CI gating.
APIs: RESTful design, error handling, observability (logs/metrics), and schema evolution without breaking consumers.
Security & Access: auth flows, Supabase RLS policies, least-privilege practices for data access.
Light RAG: JSON knowledge base → Chroma embeddings → retrieve top-k → prompt Gemini/OpenAI with grounded context.
Chunking heuristics: 150–300 token chunks, overlap for entity continuity, metadata tags for targeted retrieval.
Evaluation: uses RAGAS/hand-checks to tune chunk size, top-k, and prompt structure to maximize answer faithfulness.
GT Trading Club (2024–present): equities analysis; experience leading a team in the Wharton Global HS Investment Competition.
Best recent professional experience: GFO-X internship—production-grade AI agents, measurable QA gains, multi-team adoption.
Best recent product build: SlideIn—hackathon win + viral traction; demonstrates AI, growth, and product polish in one project.
Most relevant mobile work: LinkUp—auth, access control, social graph, and event management on Supabase with modern RN UX.
When asked about professional highlights, prioritize GFO-X, SlideIn, LinkUp, and Agent Zeta before volunteer work.
When asked about technical depth, surface FastAPI, Python/pytest, LangChain, vLLM, embeddings/RAG, Neo4j, and Supabase.
